_README: Canonical source of truth for the harness's pure-data decision constants, shared by the Python harness (adapter/harness/) and the TypeScript harness (packages/harness/src/). Edit THIS file, then run `node spec/gen-harness-core.mjs` to regenerate adapter/harness/_core_generated.py and packages/harness/src/_core-generated.ts. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) fails if the generated files are stale. See docs/adr/004-shared-semantic-core.md (Phase C1). The ~150-line resolver ALGORITHM stays hand-mirrored in control_state.py / resolve-control-state.ts and is guarded by scripts/harness-conformance/compare.mjs.

recovery_action_dependencies._README: recovery_action_class -> dimension names that class requires to be unblocked. Cross-dimension only: a recovery action must never depend on the dimension it is recovering, or a single blocked dimension would always detect as a deadlock self-loop.

dimension_recovery._README: sub-dimension name -> the recovery_action_class for that dimension.

layer_tier._README: verification layer -> epistemic tier. mechanical: exit code / schema / deterministic state inspection. environmental: inspects already-gathered external observations. model: requires semantic judgment (SKIPPED in the mechanical/environmental verifier; a future LLM-judge tier).

recovery_classification_table._README: criticism002 #7 / docs/adr/004-shared-semantic-core.md. failure_class -> { policy, action }: a CLASSIFIED failure short-circuits recovery selection to `action`; an UNCLASSIFIED failure (a class not in this map, or no class at all) falls through to recovery.py's existing next_strategy(STRATEGY_ORDER) + softmax unchanged. DATA + TYPES ONLY in Phase C2 — wiring into recovery.py / recovery.ts is Phase D. `action` values are recovery_action_class names (see dimension_recovery) plus the two terminal pseudo-actions `escalate` (surface to the human, do not auto-retry) and `escalation_halt` (terminate the objective).
